question: The marks scored by 10 students are given below. 20, 16, 16, 19, 16, 12, 19, 10, 14, 18 The mode of the given data is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The mode is simply the value that appears most frequently in the dataset.

In the given data: 20, 16, 16, 19, 16, 12, 19, 10, 14, 18

The number 16 appears 3 times, which is the highest frequency among all the numbers.

**∴ The correct answer is 16 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marks of 10 students: 20, 16, 16, 19, 16, 12, 19, 10, 14, 18

**Formula Used:**

Mode = The observation with the highest frequency in a given set of data.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let us arrange the given marks in ascending order to easily count their frequencies.

⇒ Sorted data: 10, 12, 14, 16, 16, 16, 18, 19, 19, 20

⇒ Frequency of 10 = 1

⇒ Frequency of 12 = 1

⇒ Frequency of 14 = 1

⇒ Frequency of 16 = 3

⇒ Frequency of 18 = 1

⇒ Frequency of 19 = 2

⇒ Frequency of 20 = 1

⇒ The mark 16 has the maximum frequency of 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 16 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean

The mean is the average of the dataset. Formula: Mean = Sum of all observations ÷ Total number of observations.

Median

The median is the middlemost value of the sorted data. If n is even, Median = Average of (n/2)th and (n/2 + 1)th terms.

Empirical Relationship

The statistical relationship between the three measures of central tendency is: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.

Bimodal and Multimodal Data

A dataset with exactly two modes is called bimodal, while a dataset with more than two modes is called multimodal.
